# Appendix I: Main Activities related of the Data Section carried out in 2026 {#AppDataSectionActivities}

```{r DSActivities}
capacity_building_table <- data.table::fread("../data/iotc_data_section_activities_2026.csv")

block_caption("Summary of data section activities held in late 2026", 
              style = "Table Caption", 
              autonum = run_autonum(seq_id = 'tab', 
                                    bkm = "DSActivities", 
                                    start_at = 1,

                                    prop = fp_text_lite(bold = TRUE))
)

FlexouilleLaTableMonDalon(capacity_building_table[, .(Category, `Country / CPC`, Mode, Dates, Summary)]) |> flextable::merge_v(j = 1) |> flextable::width(width = c(1.1, 0.9, 0.7, 0.9, 3.8))
```
